checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality

checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 28 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -0.1% vs its 20-SMA, -2.2% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 0 of 1 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: VOL is a hard FAIL with volume below the prior session (0.90x) and well below the 50-session average (0.92x), and the base is 28 sessions — outside Bonde's 3–20 window — triggering the catalyst-volume requirement that bars cannot satisfy; the base shaded box on the chart shows a wide, declining consolidation from ~193 down to ~175 with multiple overlapping red and green bars across nearly six weeks, confirming the loose, extended base the numbers flag. The signal bar itself closes near its high (close_pos 0.95) and shows genuine range expansion over the prior 5 bars, but those positives cannot overcome a volume FAIL and a structurally defective base.
claude.key_risk: The 28-session declining base with insufficient volume on the burst day means there is no institutional accumulation signal to support follow-through.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst-day close of 180.67 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below the prior session's pace.
